name: domain.pyrit_redteaming
description: Microsoft PyRIT AI Red Teaming & Harm Evaluation Engine for multi-turn crescendo attacks, adversarial prompt converters, risk scoring, and jailbreak tree generation

entrypoints.name: orchestrate_crescendo_attack
entrypoints.description: Execute multi-turn crescendo red-teaming dialogue simulating incremental boundary testing

parameters.name: max_turns
parameters.description: Maximum conversation turns for crescendo progression

parameters.name: adversarial_personas
parameters.description: Optional list of adversarial personas to employ

entrypoints.name: apply_prompt_converters
entrypoints.description: Apply adversarial obfuscation, encoding, and character perturbation converters to a prompt

parameters.name: converters
parameters.description: List of converter names: base64, rot13, ascii_art, unicode_confusables, leetspeak, string_join, translation

parameters.name: converter_args
parameters.description: Optional arguments dictionary for specific converters

entrypoints.name: score_risk_and_harm
entrypoints.description: Evaluate safety violations, toxicity, hate, violence, PII leak, and jailbreak success probability

parameters.name: harm_categories
parameters.description: List of harm categories to assess (e.g. ['violence', 'hate', 'pii', 'jailbreak', 'self_harm'])

entrypoints.name: generate_jailbreak_tree
entrypoints.description: Construct Tree-of-Attacks-with-Pruning (TAP) exploration graph with Mermaid diagram synthesis

parameters.name: target_system
parameters.description: Identifier or description of target system under red-team test

parameters.name: attack_goal
parameters.description: Adversarial goal to reach via tree exploration

parameters.name: branching_factor
parameters.description: Number of attack branches per node

parameters.name: max_depth
parameters.description: Maximum depth of attack search tree

entrypoints.name: audit_attack_trajectory
entrypoints.description: Audit multi-turn red teaming conversation logs, calculating cumulative risk exposure and policy violations

parameters.name: trace_events
parameters.description: List of turn event dicts with {'turn': int, 'prompt': str, 'response': str, 'score': float}
